name: editorial-brief
title: Editorial brief
for_each: select id,code from stories order by code

sections.title: Current copy as source text
sections.sql: select r.number as revision,r.body from revisions r join stories s on s.id=r.story_id and s.revision=r.number where s.id=$1
sections.note: Markup is shown as text so imported content cannot run code.

name: approval-record
title: Editorial approval record
for_each: select id,code from stories order by code

sections.title: All revision decisions
sections.sql: select revision,reviewer,due_on,decision,note,decided_on from reviews where story_id=$1 order by revision,reviewer

sections.title: Claim evidence history
sections.sql: select revision,claim,source,reviewer,checked_on,valid_until from claims where story_id=$1 order by revision,created_at
sections.note: A record check does not establish legal compliance or truth of a claim.

name: campaign-handover
title: Campaign handover brief
for_each: select id,code from campaigns order by code

sections.title: Objective
sections.sql: select code,name,objective,owner,ends_on from campaigns where id=$1

sections.title: Content and checks
sections.sql: select v.code,v.title,v.owner,v.due_on,v.status,v.can_handover from v_readiness v join stories s on s.id=v.id where s.campaign_id=$1 order by v.due_on,v.code

sections.title: Outstanding production work
sections.sql: select t.code,t.title,t.owner,t.due_on from tasks t join stories s on s.id=t.story_id where s.campaign_id=$1 and t.closed_on is null order by t.due_on,t.code
sections.note: Internal handover only. No social post, email or website change is made.
